file_id: Arati Mondal vs Unknown on 14 May, 2024

sentences.text: Arati Mondal vs Unknown on 14 May, 2024
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh 14.05.2024

Serial no. 6 [G.S.D] CRR 1615 of 2024 In the matter of : Arati Mondal ... ... Petitioner Mr. Krishan Ray Mr. Apurba Ghosh ... for the petitioner Mr. Debasish Roy Mr. Arijit Ganguly Ms.
Srimoyee Roy ... for the State
The records of the case reflect that the case was initiated in the year 2010 and, after 14 years, not even a single witness has been examined.
The case is under sections 498A/304B of the IPC being Sessions Case No. 16 of 2014 pending before the ld. Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Fast Track Court, Durgapur.

entities.text: Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Fast Track Court, Durgapur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The records of the case also reflect that there has been a design to frustrate the process of the criminal court.
As such, I direct the Deputy Commissioner of Police in charge of Andal P.S. to act as a Nodal Officer of this case for ensuring the availability of the witnesses on the date so fixed.
The ld. trial court i.e. ld. Addl. Dist. & Sessions Judge, Fast Track Court, Durgapur would fix a schedule consisting of four dates and fix such schedule once in a month.

entities.text: Addl. Dist. & Sessions Judge, Fast Track Court, Durgapur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In case, any witness is not present on the date so fixed, in that case, the Deputy Commissioner of Police in charge of the case, who would be acting as a Nodal Officer of the case, would submit a report regarding the reasons for non-availability of the witnesses before the ld. trial court.
All efforts be taken to conclude the prosecution witness by 31 st of December, 2024.
No unnecessary adjournments be granted to any of the parties.
Ld. Public Prosecutor conducting the case would produce the materials, exhibits and documents on the date so fixed for examination of the witnesses.
All stakeholders would cooperate with the ld. trial court so that the trial of the case is concluded by 31st of December, 2024.
The trial of the case would continue in spite of any resolution of the local Bar and the participating advocates in any manner or the other will not stall the proceedings in spite of such resolution.
With the aforesaid observations, CRR 1615 of 2024 is disposed of.
Pending application, if any, is also disposed of.
Parties to act on a server copy of this order duly collected from the official website of the Hon'ble High Court, Calcutta.
Urgent Photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties subject to compliance with all requisite formalities.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
